mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, type, priority, status, sla_deadline FROM t_work_order WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND sla_deadline < NOW() LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT w.id, w.order_no, w.type, w.priority, w.status, w.updated_at FROM t_work_order w JOIN t_sla_config c ON c.type = w.type AND c.priority = w.priority WHERE w.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, c.accept_minutes, w.updated_at) <= NOW() ORDER BY w.updated_at LIMIT #{batchSize}
SELECT w.id FROM t_work_order w LEFT JOIN t_sla_config c ON c.type = w.type AND c.priority = w.priority WHERE w.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND c.id IS NULL ORDER BY w.updated_at LIMIT #{batchSize}
